name: Sims Mod Health
tagline: An offline-first Windows companion for The Sims 4 mods and custom content, focused on safe diagnostics and evidence-aware compatibility checks.
problem: Players often cannot distinguish duplicates, unsupported mods, partial metadata and actual conflicts across a changing collection of Sims 4 custom content.
scenario: The desktop utility inspects local Mods data without executing scripts and produces a diagnostic view of known, unknown and potential compatibility concerns.
differentiation: Bounded local inspection and fingerprinting keep raw mod assets on the device while preserving uncertainty in shared registry evidence.
architecture: Windows Mods path -> safe DBPF and script-archive scanning -> local SQLite records -> optional registry version hints -> user-visible health report.
limitations: Unknown metadata is not confirmed breakage. Neither scanning nor registry signals can guarantee compatibility across every patch; raw mods and save files stay local unless a separately authorized workflow says otherwise.
